1.t: Nun By the pen! By all they write!

2.t: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:

3.t: you will have a never-ending reward––

4.t: truly you have a strong character––

5.t: and soon you will see, as will they,

6.t: which of you is afflicted with madness.

7.t: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.

8.t: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––

9.t: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––

10.t: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,

12.t: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,

13.t: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.

14.t: Just because he has wealth and sons,

15.t: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’

16.t: We shall brand him on the snout!

17.t: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning

18.t: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:

19.t: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept

20.t: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.

21.t: Still they called each other at daybreak,

22.t: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’

24.t: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––

25.t: they left early, bent on their purpose-

26.t: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!

28.t: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-

29.t: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-

30.t: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.

31.t: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,

32.t: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’

33.t: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.

34.t: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.

35.t: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?

36.t: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?

37.t: Do you have a Scripture that tells you

38.t: that you will be granted whatever you choose?

39.t: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?

40.t: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.

41.t: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.

42.t: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,

43.t: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].

44.t: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;

45.t: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.

46.t: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?

47.t: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?

48.t: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:

49.t: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,

50.t: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.

51.t: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’

52.t: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
